facebook_post.label: Facebook post: 1 image (1080x1350, 4:5) in a layout variant (FB-1 panel + visual, FB-2 before/after, FB-3 icon row, FB-4 light sweep; Roman's row: FB-R1); German text, logo and website drawn by the app; rotates between packages

facebook_ad.label: Facebook ad: 1 creative (1080x1350, 4:5) in a layout variant (FA-1 offer panel, FA-2 before/after, FA-3 features; Roman: FA-R1) with the German button text on the image, plus primary text, headline, description and a CTA button from Meta's list; separate from Facebook posts; nothing is placed or paid

linkedin_post.label: LinkedIn post: 1 image (1080x1440, 3:4, logo at a side corner) in a layout variant (LI-1 headline + visual, LI-2 panel + visual, LI-3 icon row, LI-4 light sweep; Roman's row: LI-R1); German text, logo and website drawn by the app

instagram_carousel.label: Instagram carousel: 5-6 static PNG slides (1080x1080, 1:1, no people, no slide numbers) in a layout variant (CS-1 neon statement, CS-2 numbered points, CS-3 centred cover, CS-4 condensed blocks): cover, 3-4 points, closing question with Liken/Teilen/Speichern; logo and optional website only on the last slide; German caption, hashtags and alt text

reel_short.label: Short vertical video (reel), up to 90 s

monthlyPlan._note: v5 (PRD R7.3): `ca plan month YYYY-MM`. About 2 graphics a day, 30-60 a month; a carousel counts as one. mix: shares per 60 (PRD default LinkedIn 16, Facebook post 16, Instagram carousel 16, Facebook ad 12), scaled to the month. romanEvery: every n-th LinkedIn/Facebook post or ad is planned with Roman (requires_roman, his LoRA). Edit freely.
